description: This PHP source file defines the LDAPDao class, which handles LDAP-related database operations within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It includes methods for querying user data, employee info, LDAP providers, and sync status.

classes.name: LDAPDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for LDAP-related database operations, extending the BaseDao class.

methods.name: getEmpNumbersWhoHaveManyUsers
methods.description: Retrieves employee numbers of users who are associated with multiple user accounts.

methods.name: getNonLocalUserByUserName
methods.description: Fetches a non-local user with a given username, ensuring the user is not password-protected (likely LDAP users).

methods.name: getUserByUserName
methods.description: Retrieves a user by username, including associated data.

methods.name: getAuthProviderByUserUniqueId
methods.description: Gets LDAP auth provider info for a user identified by a unique ID.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Searches for an employee based on various LDAP filter parameters.

methods.name: getAllLDAPAuthProviders
methods.description: Returns all LDAP authentication providers linked to active users.

methods.name: getLastLDAPSyncStatus
methods.description: Fetches the most recent LDAP sync status record.
